description_sq:
Pallati ndodhet buze rruges Kodra e Diellit, i pari sapo nis ngjitjen per ne koder, afer ne distance ecje nga zonat kryesore perreth (Komuna e Parisit, Blloku dhe Liqeni Artificial).
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te ndertimit me ashensor. Me siperfaqe totale 85m2, organizohet si 1+1 me ballkon te gjere. Te dy dhomat dhe ballkoni orientohen nga Jugu. Jo vetem ka drite dielli por edhe pamje te lire e te gjelberuar nga Kopshti Botanik, bashke me gjithe privatesine qe sjell mungesa e ndertimve perballe.
Planimetria eshte e shftyrezuar maksimalisht ndaj ky apartament 1+1 ka hapesire dhe cdo gje ne vendin e vet.
Per me teper informacion apo nje vizite ne prone ju ftoj te kontaktoni!
description_en: The palace is located on the edge of Kodra e Diellit street, the first one just starts the climb up the hill, close to walking distance from the main areas around (Paris Commune, Block and Artificial Lake). The apartment is located on the 4th floor of the building with an elevator. With a total area of ​​85m2, it is organized as 1+1 with a wide balcony. Both rooms and the balcony face South. Not only is there sunlight, but also a free and green view from the Botanical Garden, along with all the privacy that the lack of buildings in front brings. The layout is maximally simplified, so this 1+1 apartment has space and everything in its place. For more information or a visit to the property, I invite you to contact me!
